# book_action (Resource)

The action records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Tengo script code to execute
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Action name
- `owner_id` (String) Owning organization ID
- `trigger` (String) Activity type that triggers this action, or the name of an event a node in reach declares

### Optional

- `act_as` (String) Identity the action acts as. Defaults to creator.
- `continue_on_fail` (Boolean) Whether to continue executing remaining actions if this one fails
- `dedup_mode` (String) Deduplication scope for queued runs
- `description` (String) Action description
- `icon` (String) The library icon the action is shown with: a glyph name, text or a raw svg
- `input` (Dynamic) Input parameters configuration for the action
- `public` (Boolean) Whether action is public/shareable
